preconditions.description: The number of students n is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of buses k is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of days d is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split('\n')) == d and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in return_value.split('\n')))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or consists of d lines, each containing n integers.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= int(bus) <= k for line in return_value.split('\n') for bus in line.split())
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, each bus number in the output is between 1 and k inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(len(set(buses[i] for buses in [line.split() for line in return_value.split('\n')])) == n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, no two students are in the same bus for all d days.
